background.text: At the Belvedere Leonardo drew a monthly allowance but stood outside the great public commissions: Raphael held the Stanze, Michelangelo the tomb of Julius, and to Leonardo, past sixty, fell technical reconnaissance. The content of the period is the colored map of the Pontine marshes, Windsor RL 12684, of about 1514 to 1515, answering the drainage concession granted to Giuliano A ; the survey of the harbor of Civitavecchia; geometry, above all the quadrature of lunes; and experiments with mirrors and burning mirrors. The halt of his dissections upon denunciation to the papal court exposes the normative constraints of the curial environment as a patronage system, and the draft letters to Giuliano are the rare surviving instance of Leonardo composing a defense of his own position.
